name: Public File Service Health Check
description: Read-only nightly health check of the Drive→GCS sync pipeline behind the public file service: sync-service is up, the Drive watch is active (renew if expired), and GCS is fresh. Reports HEALTHY/DEGRADED/FAILED.

steps.title: Check sync-service status
steps.description:
⚠️ READ-ONLY STEP.

Check the sync-service Cloud Run service is up and serving on ${sync_service_url}.

steps.title: Verify the Drive watch is active
steps.description:
⚠️ READ-ONLY STEP.

Verify the Drive watch registration is active and not expired.

steps.title: Renew the watch if expired
steps.description: If the watch is expired, trigger renewal on the sync-service. If active, no action.
steps.accept_criteria: Watch active after this step (renewed if it was expired).

steps.title: Check GCS freshness and report
steps.description:
⚠️ READ-ONLY STEP.

Check the GCS bucket prefix (${gcs_bucket}/public/) is fresh and consistent with Drive, then produce a HEALTHY/DEGRADED/FAILED report.
steps.accept_criteria: Freshness checked. Health report produced with verdict.
